title: Transferring Inventory (Desktop and RF)

children: The inventory transfer process allows you to move product from one location within your warehouse to another location. You may initiate an inventory transfer request from the desktop or from an RF device. After the transfer is invoked, the system moves the inventory immediately as soon as you complete the transaction. You can also transfer at the license plate level. This allows you to process mixed product in one transaction. If the location supports license plate tracking, you can identify license plate information during the transactions.

You can also have the system generate work instructions for certain 
 types of inventory transfers (performed from the desktop). This allows transferred quantities 
 to not show up as available in 
 a location until the quantity is actually present (on 
 hand) in the location.  The system will mark this quantity 
 as "            in transit" in the To location, 
 and             "allocated" in the From Location.

Company transfers can only be performed on locations where their entire quantity is in an Available or  On Hand status. You cannot perform a company transfer on product at the shipping dock, the receiving dock, or the receiving "pre-check in" location.

Select the Inventory Transfer Screen from the system menu. The system will display the Adjustment Type Field.
Use the Adjustment Type Field to select a transfer type. The system will display the user and warehouse authorized adjustment types.

Using Inventory Attributes With Inventory Transfers...

You can only transfer inventory (which includes inventory attributes) only if you access the Inventory Transfer screen from the inventory record via the Inventory Insight screen. If you access the Inventory Transfer screen directly from the main menu, then inventory with attributes cannot be transferred.

If you try to perform a transfer (Desktop or RF) to/from a location that has inventory attributes, 
the system will display an error when selecting a location inventory record from the Inventory Insight screen that represents multiple inventory attributes.  If the "Show All License Plates And/Or Inventory Attributes" checkbox on the insight screen is selected, then the system will transfer inventory for the selected record.
When you access RF inventory management directly from the RF Main Menu screen, the system does not transfer inventory linked to inventory attributes.

Any time you perform a transfer from system menu for a location having inventory with and without attribute or inventory with different attributes, system always brings up the oldest record and the transfer is done to the record that was shown.

Transferring Inventory (Desktop and RF)
        The inventory transfer process allows you to move product from one location within your warehouse to another location. You may initiate an inventory transfer request from the desktop or from an RF device. After the transfer is invoked, the system moves the inventory immediately as soon as you complete the transaction. You can also transfer at the license plate level.          Work Creation
         System creates work based on the way user accesses and performs the Inventory Transfer using the user interface.
         
        Inventory Transfer from main menu - Adjust type as  Transfer with Work
        
             Select the adjustment type as Transfer with Work and click Transfer to adjust the inventory. The system will have inventory adjustment performed, but work will not be created. User needs to click Create Work to create the work. However in this case, in case the user closes the browser before selecting Create Work, system will prompt user to select Leave or Cancel. If user selects Cancel and user stays on the browser, system will prompt user to complete the pending transactions and create work.If user select Leave, then system will have incorrect inventory data  without work being created.
        
        Inventory Transfer from main menu - License Plate flow
        When user performs inventory transfer using the license plate option, then work gets created immediately when user clicks Transfer button.
         
        Inventory transfer screen from Insight Screen - Work gets created automatically when user clicks the Transfer button.
